text:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — AtlasX confirmed 5 seats for the beta but asked for a staggered enablement over 3 weeks due to internal compliance reviews. They specifically flagged SSO + data residency as blockers. Can we lock an enablement cadence and a simple feedback capture plan?

Ben (CS Ops): I can run logistics. Tentative slots Mon 10am or Tue 2pm PT. Need to know: will we do per-seat onboarding or a group run-through? Also need their account IDs and which environments they want access to. cc @Kai

Kai (SE): Per-seat will help with integration debugging but is heavier on our time. Proposal: Week1 group kickoff (60m) + Week2 two 30m sandbox sessions for the first 3 seats + Week3 final 30m for last 2 seats + async follow-ups. SSO note: they use Okta with SCIM — plan for a test SAML app before prod.

Jordan (PM): Agree with Kai. For feedback capture: short survey after each session + a 3-prompt regression test we run against their sample prompts. If responses drop > 10% in quality we flag to eng.

Maya (CSM): Sounds good. Action items: 1) confirm slots with AtlasX, 2) get their Okta admin contact + test tenant, 3) ask for 3 representative prompts and an example failure case for our regression suite.

Ben (CS Ops): Drafting the invite now. Quick runbook snippet I’ll paste into the calendar invite:

```
Pre-call (30m): collect SSO test creds, desired environments, sample prompts
Kickoff (60m): intro, architecture, access walkthrough
Sandbox sessions (30m each): hands-on integration + sample prompt tuning
Follow-up (15m): capture survey + assign any bugs to eng
```

Kai (SE): Also request log-level=debug for one test run so we can map any tokenization/response issues to model settings. If AtlasX wants private deployment later, we should surface quantization/latency expectations now.

Maya (CSM): I’ll message their PM (sara@atlasx) and propose Mon 10am PT for kickoff and Tue/Thu sandboxes.

cs-bot: Task created: "AtlasX beta enablement — schedule + feedback plan" -> project: beta-onboard, ticket: BETA-4421 :white_check_mark:

Ben (CS Ops): Flagging a renewal risk if we stall >3 weeks — their procurement team wants an initial success metric before committing to Dedicated. We should prioritize SSO test and the first sandbox. :warning:

Jordan (PM): Good call. I’ll prepare the 3-prompt regression harness (will share the repo link in thread) and a brief success criteria doc: "connect + run prompts + <80ms median latency or documented tradeoffs".

Maya (CSM): Thanks all — I’ll confirm with AtlasX and post back with confirmed times and the Okta contact. If anyone has a preferred checklist item to add, drop it in here. :raised_hands:
